ic_name: MIPI CSI-2 (Camera Serial Interface 2, MIPI Alliance)

interrupt_sources.trigger: Master detected arbitration loss on SDA.
Receiver returned NACK when ACK expected.
Illegal condition (START or STOP at unexpected position).

interrupt_request: Interrupts are SoC-controller-specific; UM10204 lists the canonical conditions observable at the protocol layer.
notes: CSI-2 test/debug centers on the packet error-reporting (header ECC, footer CRC) and PHY error flags; there is no host-to-sensor acknowledgement on the unidirectional data path.
error_detection_mechanisms: Hamming-modified header ECC: single-bit correct / 2-bit detect.
Payload CRC-16 on Long Packets; 0xFFFF for zero-length payload; 0x0000 from non-checksum peripheral.
Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02 reverse) — 16-bit error mask.
HRX_TO / HTX_TO / LTX-P_TO / LRX-H_TO contention-recovery timers.
LP-Contention detector (LP-CD on bidirectional Data Lane 0) per §7.2.1 + Annex A.
error_reporting: Packet Header ECC: corrects single-bit, detects double-bit errors in every Long Packet header and Short Packet
Packet Footer CRC-16-CCITT detects payload corruption
PHY-level errors: SoT error, SoT sync error, control error, escape entry error reported by receiver
Frame sync error: FS without matching FE (or vice versa)
test_patterns: Sensors typically support CCI-configurable test patterns (color bar, gradient) sent as normal RAW/RGB Long Packets for receiver bring-up.
